citation: Keown et al. (2024) reproduce spider-like crack networks from CO2 sublimating inside the regolith, without surface scouring
claims: - **Mars spider troughs.** Kieffer's model erodes them by gas flow under the slab. Mc Keown et al. (2024) reproduce spider-like crack networks from CO2 sublimating inside the regolith, without surface scouring.

**Sources.** Kieffer et al. 2006 (FOUND); Piqueux et al. 2003 (FOUND); Mc Keown et al. 2021 (FOUND); Mc Keown et al. 2024 (FOUND); Soderblom et al. 1990 (FOUND); Hofgartner et al. 2022 (FOUND); Duxbury and Brown 1997 (FOUND).
